Our Story

Spotless Horizon Cleaning Services was founded to solve a simple problem: facility owners in Kebbi State needed one dependable partner for cleaning, pest control, and maintenance — instead of chasing down separate contractors for every issue. Today, we serve homes, offices, and institutions across Birnin Kebbi and beyond with the same standard of professionalism and reliability.

Our Mission

To deliver dependable, high-quality facility care that gives our clients back their time and peace of mind.
